modules.name: MTX-8
modules.description: Maschine JAM groovebox: 8x8 step sequencer driving 8 built-in synth voices (morphing oscillator, resonant filter, envelopes, drive, pan), touch strips shape each voice, stereo out

modules.name: MTX FORGE
modules.description: Maschine JAM groovebox: the MTX-8 sequencer and 8 voices, and the whole mix (plus IN L/R) through the GRAIN-FORGE FX chain, clocked by the sequencer

modules.name: MTX-DUO
modules.description: LEAD and BASS dual-oscillator mono synths (wave morph, hard sync, FM, sub, 24 dB filter, ADSR, drive, glide) with their own 8-step note sequencer in a key and scale, 8 patterns, clock/reset/run in, audio, pitch and gate out

modules.name: MTX-DRUM
modules.description: Drum-synth groovebox: 8 voices (kick, snare, clap, tom, hat, metal, FM, noise models) on the MTX 8x8 sequencer with accents, 8 patterns, strip banks, choke groups, per-voice audio and trigger outs, final filter, delay, reverb and FORGE FX, Maschine JAM control

modules.name: MTX Quad
modules.description: The quad-oscillator synth voice played by an 8x8 note grid with per-step accent, cutoff, gate, glide, chance, ratchet, octave and resonance sliders

modules.name: MTX-FX
modules.description: 8-input effects matrix played from the MTX 8x8 grid and the Maschine JAM: 8 effect slots (64 effects in 7 tabs: drive, filter, mod, glitch, delay, reverb, dynamics), 12 one-click chains, accents, 8 routing scenes, slot links and dub chains, drag-and-drop OLED setup, musical RAND, DJ filter, 60 s tempo-locked looper (MTX-ECHO's)

modules.name: MTX-ECHO
modules.description: Stereo delay and looper: 12 delay types (MTX ping-pong, clean digital, chorused, analog, tape, lo-fi, ducking, reverse, ping-pong, slap, octave shimmer, multi-head space echo), tap tempo and clock with 11 subdivisions incl. dual, freeze, kill dry, trails, reverb, 6 presets, 60 s stereo looper with overdub, play once and undo

modules.name: MTX-LOOP
modules.description: 8-track loop sampler built on the MTX-ECHO looper: record / replace, play / stop, play once, undo / redo and clear per track, tempo-locked lengths with count-in, clock or tempo knob, mono or stereo (poly) tracks, 8 inputs with gain and monitor, 8 outputs and a stereo mix, scenes, a JAM-style grid and an OLED showing all 8 loops

modules.name: MTX Composer
modules.description: Song arranger for the MTX modules: finds MTX-8, FORGE, DUO, DRUM, FX, ECHO and LOOP in the patch by itself (no cables), 8 sections A-H that set each module's pattern, mute, level and loop action, launches on the bar or beat, cycles through 1-8 sections every 1-16 bars, master clock (CLOCK, BAR, SECT) and Maschine JAM control

modules.name: JAM
modules.description: Maschine JAM controller: 8x8 pad trigger sequencer with 8 patterns, plus the 8 touch strips as CV outputs with 8 banks; JAM lights follow the module

modules.name: RANDROYD
modules.description: Track generator: builds a rack of MTX modules and a mixer, writes genre-based songs into it with an arrangement, ROLL / MUTATE / GROW, and 8 save banks of 8 tracks

modules.name: BACKDROP
modules.description: Dresses the whole rack: a background (colour, SynTHBloK looks or your image), a case around the modules from a library of case styles, and the patch title

modules.name: BLANK
modules.description: A NoiZee ToyZ blank panel for empty rack space: badge, backlit or circuit look, 3 to 32 HP
